subject: Kickoff: typology prediction for coverage planning
body:
Hi Deshawn,

Kicking off the typology-prediction project. Base: our open-source NEMO work from the SIGTYP 2020 shared task — frequentist inference for predicting a language's typological features (from WALS) given only a handful of observed ones.

Product motivation: the language portfolio's coverage planning currently treats unknown languages as blank slates. Predicted typological profiles (word order, morphology type, etc.) let the i18n teams pick tokenizers, segmentation defaults, and eval sets for languages we've never shipped — before collecting data.

Half plan: reproduce shared-task numbers by mid-April, extend to the full WALS matrix in May-June with a big imputation sweep; the deliverable is a typology-profile service proposal by the 7/6 window close.

Staffing plus compute sketch by mid-March? The full-matrix sweep may need reserved capacity.

Priya
